text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't this lineup slap?! I went and<n>got everyone
that gave me main<n>character vibes. ☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ogurizz, Bamboozler, Yae-Yae...<n>Ughhh, I'm so
pumped!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Basically, this race is gonna go hard!<n>☆ Sheesh,
this'll be lit! Woo! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Daitaku Helios hasn't even debuted<n>yet. No matter
how much talent she<n>has, running up against tested
veterans won't be easy.
choice_data_list: Honestly, I think this will be a really hard race.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Aw, don't get all emo on me. Take a<n>look out there!

text_block_list.name: Friend A
text_block_list.text: No way! Helios really did put togethera scrim with a G1 roster. No cap, Ithought the group chat was joking...

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
What in the world is she thinking? But<n>I suppose I
won't get another<n>opportunity like this—time to
analyze<n>their running!

text_block_list.name: Friend B
text_block_list.text:
Heliooos! Show 'em what the<n>blast-off captain's
got! You got this,<n>fam!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Bet! Just you watch! ☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: See? Everyone's hyped. Now I gottalight this place up.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: This race? Hard? You can't know<n>that till it's over!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, just watch me! Helios<n>boutta slay this
race with a "Wahey!"<n>Go! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She's completely relaxed, even<n>facing first-rate
competition. Maybe<n>she chose them because
she's<n>confident she can still win.
choice_data_list: Is she stronger than I gave her credit for?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Aight, let's gooo!

text_block_list.name: New Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa! Daitaku Helios just zoomed<n>out to a lead!
And she's not slowing<n>down!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Not only does she continue widening<n>the gap with
her daredevil pace, but...

text_block_list.name: Friend B
text_block_list.text: Bahaha! Let's go, Helios! Floor it!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
You got it! Get the crowd going on<n>your end!
Hahaha!

text_block_list.name: New Trainer A
text_block_list.text: She has time to chat in the middle of arace?! No way... Is she really going toclose this out front-running? Againstcompetition like this?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: No waaay!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Ahh...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: In the end, she isn't able to mount a<n>comeback....

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Pant... Ugh, blegh. I'm gonna hurl...And I came in dead last... Augh... I'm...I'm so...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: I'm so dead, fam! Ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I was in the mood to go full throttle<n>today, but I
should've known I didn't<n>have the stamina for that.
Tee-hee! ☆
choice_data_list: You didn't think you could win?!
You didn't think you could win?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yup, no way! But that was still a total<n>banger—racing
is bae! GG, me! GG,<n>everyone!

text_block_list.name: New Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Wow, that was intense. Daitaku<n>Helios... Heh,
she's an interesting<n>one. But, uh... I don't know if
I'd want<n>to work with her.

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
I can't believe she began talking to<n>the crowd
mid-race. She's utterly<n>unfocused. I wouldn't want
to go up<n>against an all-show and<n>no-substance
racer like her.

text_block_list.name: Friend B
text_block_list.text:
Helios, you really are the GOAT! You<n>gotta do this
kinda stuff more often.<n>Oh, BT-dubs, haven't you
been kinda<n>flaky lately?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: I knooow! Let's hang more—LANE me<n>up! Later! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Daitaku Helios doesn't show even<n>an atom of
frustration at coming in<n>last. Surely, she's just
keeping it<n>inside.
choice_data_list: Uh... You are upset about losing, right?
Um... You are upset about losing, right?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, you'd think, right? Nope! ☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I mean, it'd be fire if I won, duh! But<n>losing's not
really an L, y'know?<n>I've never worried about it
before!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Like, it was so fun! Everyone's allsmiles! I had a blast! Calling this abad time would be cap!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
This isn't a front—she's smiling from<n>the bottom of
her heart. Normal<n>students shed tears over
competition,<n>but then again, Daitaku Helios is far
from "normal".

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Whoa, are your hands all right?<n>They're red
as hell.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I look down to see nail marks printed<n>into my
palms. I must have<n>unconsciously clenched my
fists too<n>tightly when I thought she might win.
choice_data_list: (I was so excited. But in the end...)

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I almost forgot! We were talking<n>about the
contract thing, right? What<n>do you—

text_block_list.name: Friend C
text_block_list.text:
Heliboss! Jordan and I are gonna go<n>grab a bite.
Wanna come?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Coming!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Hwha?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I may have gotten to see her run, but<n>now I'm more
confused than before.<n>At the very least, I want to
ask<n>what's really important to her.
choice_data_list: What does racing mean to you?
What does racing mean to you?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Life! Long! Party! Bye! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Her running was enchanting. It made<n>me think, "She
might pull off<n>something incredible!" That said...
choice_data_list: (Her dream is a lifelong party, huh?)

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
All dreams are created equal, but I'm<n>still a trainer. I
want to work with<n>someone who truly wants to win.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Racing is beautiful because the racers<n>compete with
all they have. So far, I<n>haven't found a shred of
seriousness in her.
choice_data_list: (I need to learn more about her.)

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
So I decide to go out into town on my<n>day off to look
for Daitaku Helios...<n>and there she is, merrily
walking<n>around.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's you! Perfect timing! You free?<n>Wanna
dance?!
